main_text.l: famin. נִטִּילָה rfferebatur, Dan.7.4. Pihel נָטַל Levare.
נְטִילִים m. p. Portatores, Bajuli, Levantes.
נָטַע נָטַע נָטַע m. Planta: plurale, נְטָעִים, מַטָּעִים, נִטָּעִים, Planta.
נָטַף Stillare, Deftillare. Hiphil הִטִּיף idem, metaphoricè, loqui, Prophetare.
נֵטֶף m. Stilla, Stacte, Gutta myrrhæ.
נִטְפּוֹת f. p. Myrothecidia, Stillatoria vasculæ vel juxta quosdam, Torques, Monilia.
נָטַר Custodire, Servare, Asservare. Sic Chald. נְטַר Servavi, Dan.7.28.
מַטָּרָה f. Custodia, Carcer: item, Scopus, quem Observant sagittarii ad eum collimando. Semel cum א in fine.
Extendere, Diffundere se. Niphal נִטַּשׁ Deseri, Extendi. Pyhal טִשַּׁשׁ Idem.
נְטִישׁוֹת f. p. Propagines, Sarmenta: Pinna.
מָנוֹן נִין m. Filius, Hinc Verbum in Niphal יִנּוֹן Sobolescet, Psal.72.17.
נִיר Hiphil הֵנִיר Novellavit, Novavit agrum.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek words are transcribed as far as legible; some vocalisation marks in the scan are faint and uncertain. The word "rfferebatur" is printed as shown (for "offerebatur"). Several Hebrew forms in the Hiphil and Niphal lines are only approximately legible.
